_comment: One real before/after example showing the L1+L2 win on a chart-bearing slide. Numbers come from an actual deployment run on a U.S. federal-agency public-domain presentation. The deck identifier is anonymized; the raw narration text, evidence kinds, and confidence values are recorded verbatim from the pipeline output. See outputs/emnlp_industry/chart_example.md for the human-readable version.
slide_summary: Bar chart of Win2k service-pack counts over five dates (March 2001 to March 2002). The chart is an EMBEDDED_OLE_OBJECT shape referencing an embedded Excel .xlsx workbook.

before.code_state: pre-L1 (script generator picked first matching kind) and pre-L2 (no CHART_* evidence extraction)
before.narration: This slide shows a diagram with key elements: Win2k, Service, Packs, 71.

after.code_state: post-L1 (script generator prefers SLIDE_CAPTION when conf >= 0.8) and post-L2 (CHART_* kinds extracted from embedded .xlsx)
after.narration: The bar graph illustrates the number of service packs for Win2k over time, highlighting significant increases in service pack levels SP1 and SP2 compared to SP0.

what_changed.L1: Script generator now ranks vision evidence by confidence; a 0.95-confidence SLIDE_CAPTION wins over a 0.4-confidence DIAGRAM_SUMMARY regardless of list order.
what_changed.L2: Embedded Excel OLE workbooks are walked via openpyxl; each chart's title, categories, series, and per-data-point values become first-class CHART_* evidence at confidence 1.0.

what_did_not_change.headline_proxy_rate: The keyword-based proxy-flagged rate on this slide is the same before and after (neither narration contains any of the 24 visual-embellishment keywords). The improvement is in narration informativeness, not in the headline 7.89%->1.79% number.
what_did_not_change.chart_screenshot_case: If the chart had been a rendered PNG screenshot (no embedded data, no native chart object), neither L1 nor L2 would have helped; that case is named in Limitations as future work.

notes: This example was captured from a real deployment pipeline run on 2026-05-25 with full vision + AI narration enabled. Pre-fix and post-fix were two separate end-to-end runs against the same PPTX file.
